title: All-Hands Theme Synopsis and Microtalks - Q3 Playbook (v0.1)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact playbook for the next company all-hands (target week: first full week of Q3 planning). Goal is to give a tight executive signal, align around a small set of company priorities and OKR hypotheses, and surface operational signals via 5–8 minute microtalks from teams.

Audience:
- Entire company (eng, product, go-to-market, ops, security)
- Particularly: managers and above (to cascade) + individual contributors for visibility

High-level framing (proposed theme):
- Theme title: ‘Operate with Fewer Surprises’
- One-sentence framing: Reinforce reliability-first shipping while creating predictable runway for the next 6 months — fewer outages, fewer regressions, clearer capacity planning, and predictable product delivery.
- Why: many partners and customers are moving to Dedicated/Private; our tangible advantage is predictable inference economics. We need to emphasize reliability, observability, and rollout rigor as the runway to capture enterprise commitments.

All-hands backbone (60–75 minutes total):
1) Kick (5 min) — CEO: one-line posture + one ask for every manager (make one operational change this week).
2) Exec update (15 min) — CRO + CTO: top signals (customer commitments, capacity utilization, incident posture, revenue health).
3) OKR snapshot (10–12 min) — Head of Product: 3 candidate company OKRs (headline + metric + current baseline).
4) Microtalks (20–25 min) — four 5–6 minute lightning updates from teams; each follows the template below.
5) Ask and cascade (5–8 min) — PMO: what managers should do this sprint, open sync signups.
6) Live Q&A (10–15 min) — pre-queued + live.

Proposed OKR headlines (draft; quant & baseline placeholders):
- Objective A — Production Stability and Predictability:
  - KR1: Reduce P99 serving latency regressions to < 0.5 incidents/month (baseline: 1.7 in last quarter).
  - KR2: Achieve 99.95% uptime for Hosted API across primary regions (baseline: 99.85%).
  - KR3: Onboard two strategic enterprise customers on Dedicated with validated SLO/latency targets (baseline: 0).
  - Owner: SRE + serving-runtime roadmap lead.

- Objective B — Unit Economics and Cost Control:
  - KR1: Reduce average per-token cost for high-throughput routes by 18% via batching/quantization (baseline: median cost from last month).
  - KR2: Launch Optimize suggestions for top 3 customer archetypes with measurable savings (baseline: none shipped).
  - Owner: Optimize + Product Economics.

- Objective C — Developer Experience and Rollout Safety:
  - KR1: Ship per-route rollout controls (canary + auto-fallback) to customers with >50% adoption among Active Admins (baseline: feature prototype).
  - KR2: Reduce mean time to detect regression in model outputs from 36h to < 8h using eval anchors (baseline: 36h).
  - Owner: Console + Developer Experience.

Microtalk format and candidates (5–6 minutes each):
- Strict template: 30s context, 90s one metric signal, 90s what we changed or will change, 60s ask (what we need from the company). Keep slides to max 3.
- Suggested microtalks (tentative):
  1) Serving Runtime — ‘KV cache wins in the wild’ (speaker: Lina Park). Metric: cache hit-rate improvement and cost delta. Ask: product teams to identify 2 routes for cache trials.
  2) Dedicated — ‘Onboarding playbook beta’ (speaker: Marco Silva). Metric: time-to-onboard reduced from 8 weeks to 5.5 weeks in pilot. Ask: sales/solutions to nominate next pilot.
  3) Optimize — ‘Batching profile suggestions’ (speaker: Eunice Zhou). Metric: end-to-end per-token cost delta for batched traffic. Ask: engineering teams to opt into A/B for two routes.
  4) Security & Private — ‘VPC audit learnings’ (speaker: Ahmed Ibrahim). Metric: checklist compliance rate and one post-mortem. Ask: two legal/enterprise customers to review the proposed data flow diagram.

Pre-read (to be sent 72 hours before):
- Executive one-pager (2 pages): current capacity, bookings cadence, known risks. (link: confluence://company/all-hands-pre-read-q3)
- Draft OKR canvas (one-pager per Objective) — internal link placeholder.
- Microtalk slide templates and speaker notes (drive link).

Communication plan and owners:
- Save the date (internal calendar invite): Priya to send next Monday.
- Pre-read distribution 72h prior: Jamal to finalize and attach.
- Slides collated & dry run: Speakers to submit slides 3 days before; dry run with comms team 48h before.
- Manager cascade kit (email + short script): Maya.

Risk register (top 6 quick notes):
- R1: Too many OKRs = dilution. Mitigate by keeping at most 3 company objectives and moving other targets to team plans.
- R2: Microtalks run long. Mitigate by strict timing and one-chime policy.
- R3: Exec message mismatch (sales vs engineering posture). Mitigate by pre-sync between CRO and CTO two days prior.
- R4: Pre-read low-read rate. Mitigate with a 3-bullet TL;DR and manager-level nudges.
- R5: Heavy incident in the week of the all-hands. Mitigate with contingency plan: replace exec update with incident state and a rapid forum.
- R6: Speaker no-shows. Mitigate: pre-record or have backup speaker list.

Operational notes (notes-to-self / meeting-style):
- Keep the opening ask practical and uniform: each manager walks away with one thing they will change this week. That improves signal.
- Encourage microtalk speakers to surface both wins and the remaining question — this helps other teams offer targeted help.
- Consider running a 48h mini-survey post-all-hands for 3 quick metrics: clarity on priorities, useful micros, and manager-ready takeaways.

Open decisions (items needing sign-off):
1) Finalize theme (Ops-first vs Growth-first). Recommendation: Ops-first for this cycle; ask execs to sign off by EOD Friday.
2) Lock microtalk speakers (need confirmation from Lina/Marco/Eunice/Ahmed).
3) Confirm OKR owners: SRE, Product Economics, Console — owners to accept by next Wednesday.

Next steps + timeline (owner in parens):
- Today: circulate this playbook for comments (Priya).
- By Fri: exec sign-off on theme + OKR headlines (CEO + CTO + CRO).
- Next Mon: calendar invites + preliminary pre-read (Jamal).
- Day -3 to all-hands: slides due from speakers; dry run scheduled (Maya).
- Post all-hands: 48h action register + manager cascade packet (Ruth).

Appendix: Microtalk slide checklist (for speakers) — put into slide template:
- Slide 1: one-line problem statement + why it matters to the company.
- Slide 2: the data (one chart / one metric).
- Slide 3: the ask (concrete, who to contact, and timeline).

Other notes / fringe ideas (optional):
- Consider having two anonymous real-time polls during Q&A: one for clarity on OKRs and one for what folks need this week.
- Small experiment: route a short Slack thread for follow-ups with a pinned message for asks; collect volunteers for cross-team pairing.

Anyone reading this: please add comments inline and flag anything that must change for legal/compliance presence (particularly for Dedicated/Private customer mentions).

-- end of draft playbook --
